subtitle: Lesson 34 · Cosmos DB Fundamentals & Modeling

code:
Request Unit (RU):
  normalized cost of compute + memory + I/O
  for ONE operation

1KB point read by id + partition key
  ~= 1 RU

Every response returns its exact RU charge
-> cost is knowable, not estimated after
   the fact
caption: Cosmos DB's distinctive cost/throughput currency.

eyebrow: Two ways to pay for RU/s
code:
PROVISIONED THROUGHPUT:
  fixed RU/s reserved & billed
  guaranteed capacity, predictable cost
  excess requests -> throttled

SERVERLESS:
  no reserved RU/s
  billed on RUs actually consumed
  lower max throughput/storage ceilings
caption: Steady, predictable traffic vs. spiky, low-volume traffic.
